backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining customer and order types with authorization checks and CRUD operations for profiles, customers, and orders.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing autogenerated summaries of various frontend modules and components.
frontend/ANDROID_BUILD.md: Instructions for building the Android APK including prerequisites and environment setup.
frontend/android-artifacts/.gitkeep: Placeholder file ensuring the android-artifacts directory is committed.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for Android build outputs, config files, and IDE artifacts.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Gradle configuration for the Android app including SDK versions, dependencies, and build settings.
frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidMan: Android manifest defining app metadata, permissions, activities, and deep link handling.
frontend/android/app/src/main/java/ai/ca: Main Capacitor BridgeActivity for loading the web app on Android.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawab: Splash screen drawable layering background color and centered launcher icon.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Defines primary color palette for the Android app.
String resources defining app name and package identifiers.
Android theme definitions including action bar and splash screen styles.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/fi: File provider path configuration for sharing files securely.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Project-level Gradle config specifying repositories, buildscript dependencies, and clean task.
frontend/android/gradle.properties: Gradle build settings such as JVM args and AndroidX options.
frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-w: Defines Gradle wrapper distribution URL and storage paths.
frontend/android/settings.gradle: Settings file linking the app module and Capacitor Android module.
frontend/android/variables.gradle: Centralized version variables for Android dependencies and SDK levels.
frontend/APK_DELIVERY.md: Guide for retrieving and installing the generated Android APK.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration specifying app metadata, web directory, navigation rules, and Android options.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling with custom OKLCH color variables and theme definitions.
frontend/index.html: Defines the main HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/build-android-debug.ps1: PowerShell script that builds the web app, syncs Capacitor Android, builds a debug APK, and copies it to artifacts.
frontend/scripts/build-android-debug.sh: Bash script performing the same Android debug APK build and sync steps as the PowerShell version.
frontend/scripts/copy-apk-to-artifacts.s: Copies an existing debug APK into an artifacts directory for easier retrieval.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, authorization, sync startup, and conditional rendering of login, denied, or orders pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown to authenticated but unauthorized users with logout and language switch options.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login UI using Internet Identity with a language switch and app logo.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Dropdown UI component for switching between English and Marathi.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header bar showing logo, sync status, language switch, and logout action.
frontend/src/features/orders/calculation: Utility functions for validating amounts and computing remaining payment.
frontend/src/features/orders/components/: Form section for entering customer name, phone, and address with WhatsApp-ready action.
Component that enables sending a prefilled WhatsApp 'ready' message to the customer.
Renders upper and lower body measurement inputs and propagates updates via onChange.
Displays a summary card for an order with status, details, remaining amount, and an edit action.
Provides form fields for editing item type, dates, quantities, amounts, and order status.
Dialog for creating or editing an order, handling validation, persistence, status changes, and deletion.
Modal showing a ready-for-pickup message with copy and WhatsApp sharing options.
frontend/src/features/orders/orderId.ts: Generates a unique order ID using timestamp and random characters.
frontend/src/features/orders/readyMessag: Builds a bilingual ready message and generates a WhatsApp link for sending it.
frontend/src/features/orders/storage.ts: Manages local order storage with CRUD operations, syncing flags, and helpers for pending changes.
frontend/src/features/orders/types.ts: Defines order status and item type unions plus interfaces for measurements and the LocalOrder structure with sync metadata.
frontend/src/features/sync/ordersSync.ts: Implements order synchronization with backend, handling create/update/delete cases and tracking sync results.
frontend/src/features/sync/SyncStatusBad: Renders a badge showing online, offline, syncing, or error state using connectivity and sync engine hooks.
frontend/src/features/sync/useConnectivi: Provides a hook that tracks online/offline browser connectivity state.
frontend/src/features/sync/useSyncEngine: Manages automatic and manual sync execution, status, and error handling based on connectivity and authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Verifies admin access via actor.isCallerAdmin and exposes authorization state and logout behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides identity state, login/logout, and initialization logic using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update the caller’s user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Supplies language state, persistence, and translation lookup via context.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines English and Marathi translations for UI text and exports translation utilities.
frontend/src/i18n/useT.ts: Convenience hook that returns the translation function and current language.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base and component layers with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point initializing QueryClient and wrapping the app with InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/OrdersListPage.tsx: Orders listing page with search, status filtering, sorting, and an editor dialog for creating or editing orders.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, OKLCH-based color tokens, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, architecture, and requirements for the tailoring app.
